candidates.name: Riddell–Erdős progression-free subset ratio

candidates.name: Minkowski inhomogeneous product conjecture
candidates.scope: Every nonsingular real n-by-n matrix A and real shift b admit an integer z with product_i |(Az-b)_i| <= |det A|/2^n, in every positive dimension.

candidates.name: Marcus block-permanent conjecture
candidates.scope: For every complex Hermitian PSD block matrix A, permanent(A) >= permanent([permanent(A_ij)]); with block size >= 2 and positive definite diagonal blocks, equality iff every off-diagonal block is zero.
candidates.status_note: Both the inequality and its original equality clause are retained. Two-block and low-rank results are partial. Different from the Marcus–Minc transform conjecture, now claimed proved.

candidates.name: Wang's Hadamard permanent question
